newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CEZ shares fall on results - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Czech CEZ shares fall on results - dealers.

text.p: Shares in Czech power utility CEZ a.s. dropped 45 crowns, 3.7 percent, to 1,160 on Monday after the company said that preliminary 1996 gross profits had fallen to 13.7 billion crowns from 14.78 billion in 1995.
"It (the fall) is mainly to do with the announcement on the results...I see interest now (in buying CEZ) so I don't see further decreases," said Petr Opocensky of Citicorp Securities.
CEZ, which accounts for 13.5 percent of the PX50 index's capitalisation, also said it would pay a gross dividend -- its first ever -- of 3.25 percent on 1996 profits.
Opocensky said that this could have a positive effect on the issue when the market calms down after the lower profit figures.
